name: Ribbonking Oarfish
flavor: Eight metres of silver ribbon. Sailors called it the sea serpent.
why: Lone Wolf: the longest bony fish roams the open deep by itself, and takes the room around it (Evasive left off: it only came at Level 10).

name: Moonlit Opah
flavor: The only warm-blooded fish. The cold deep never slows it.
why: Heat: the only fully warm-blooded fish runs hotter when the field is hot; Tide for an ocean fish.

name: Sunbasker Mola
flavor: It basks on its side in the sun and lays three hundred million eggs.
why: Sturdy: the heaviest bony fish with thick, leathery skin; Plenty: up to 300 million eggs; Diurnal: it basks by day.

name: Kelpmask Sea Dragon
flavor: Every frill is a scrap of kelp. It drifts with the weed.
why: Invisible and Evasive: leaf-shaped frills make it look like drifting kelp.

name: Stripeleg Okapi
flavor: Zebra legs, giraffe kin, and ears that hear a leopard coming.
why: Keen Sense: huge ears in dense forest; Confuse: its zebra-striped legs break up its outline in the shade.

name: Pressure Blobfish
flavor: Only sad at the surface. Down in the deep it is calm and in no hurry.
why: Sturdy: soft gelatinous flesh soaks up blows; Slow: no muscle to speak of, it drifts.

name: Sling-jaw Goblin Shark
flavor: Its jaw shoots forward, and the small prey is gone before the water moves.
why: Gash: the jaw shoots out on arrival and wounds what faces it; Cull: it hunts small fish, squid and shrimp.

name: Living-fossil Coelacanth
flavor: Gone for sixty-six million years, until a net brought it up in 1938.
why: Revive (on play, a fallen card returns from your graveyard): the Lazarus fish that came back from presumed extinction; Darksight: it lives in dark caves 150 metres down.

name: Steppe Saiga
flavor: A big soft nose warms the winter air. The herd runs as one.
why: Pack: saigas live and run in herds of thousands (Pack 1, since Swift on top left only 2/4).

name: Mossback Kakapo
flavor: A flightless night parrot the colour of moss. Fewer than three hundred remain.
why: Nocturnal and Invisible: it freezes among moss at night; On Death draw 1: few are left, so each one's loss is felt and learnt from.

name: Saddle Tapir
flavor: It wades, swims, and plants the forest's seeds wherever it walks.
why: Armor: thick hide; Tide: it wades and swims; On Play grows a Growth Sprout: tapirs spread seeds in their dung.

name: Glassbelly Frog
flavor: A clear belly shows its heartbeat. Father stays by the eggs.
why: Guardian: the male guards the eggs on the leaf; Expose: a see-through frog shows what hides.

name: Ringtail Red Panda
flavor: It climbs out of reach. Corner it and it rears up and slashes.
why: Evasive: a nimble tree climber; Rage: a cornered red panda stands up and strikes back hard.

name: Ventplume Tube Worm
flavor: No mouth, no gut: two metres of red plume rooted at an 80-degree vent.
why: Dry: it lives beside boiling vents; Throng: vent worms grow in dense thickets of thousands.
